bibliography.title: Triple-BERT: Do We Really Need MARL for Order Dispatch on Ride-Sharing Platforms?

sections.title: 3.3.2 Policy factorization and gradient formal component

abstract_sentences.text: On-demand ride-sharing platforms, such as Uber and Lyft, face the intricate real-time challenge of bundling and matching passengers—each with distinct origins and destinations—to available vehicles, all while navigating significant system uncertainties.

evidence.anchor: On-demand ride-sharing platforms face the real-time bundling and matching challenge

abstract_sentences.text: Due to the extensive observation space arising from the large number of drivers and orders, order dispatching, though fundamentally a centralized task, is often addressed using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL).

evidence.anchor: Order dispatching is fundamentally centralized but often addressed using MARL

abstract_sentences.text: However, independent MARL methods fail to capture global information and exhibit poor cooperation among workers, while Centralized Training Decentralized Execution (CTDE) MARL methods suffer from the Curse of Dimensionality (CoD).

evidence.anchor: Independent MARL fails global information; CTDE suffers from CoD

abstract_sentences.text: To overcome these challenges, we propose Triple-BERT, a centralized framework designed specifically for large-scale order dispatching on ride-sharing platforms based on Single Agent Reinforcement Learning (SARL).

evidence.anchor: We propose Triple-BERT, a centralized SARL framework

abstract_sentences.text: Built on a variant TD3, our approach addresses the vast action space through an action decomposition strategy that breaks down the joint action probability into individual driver action probabilities.

evidence.anchor: Action decomposition breaks joint action probability into individual driver probabilities

abstract_sentences.text: To handle the extensive observation space, we introduce a novel BERT-based network, where parameter reuse mitigates parameter growth as the number of drivers and orders increases, and the attention mechanism effectively captures the complex relationships among the large pool of driver and orders.

evidence.anchor: Parameter reuse and attention handle the extensive observation space

abstract_sentences.text: We validate our method using a real-world ride-hailing dataset from Manhattan.

evidence.anchor: We validate using a real-world ride-hailing dataset from Manhattan

abstract_sentences.text: Triple-BERT achieves approximately an 11.95% improvement over current state-of-the-art methods, with a 4.26% increase in served orders and a 22.25% reduction in pickup times.

evidence.anchor: Triple-BERT achieves approximately 11.95% improvement

abstract_sentences.text: Our code, trained model parameters, and processed data are publicly available at https://github.com/RS2002/Triple-BERT.

evidence.anchor: Code, trained parameters, and processed data are publicly available

introduction_moves.move: context: 动态匹配、需求波动、交通、司机可用性和平台多目标共同构成调度场景；并发上升把 action/observation space 推到核心问题。上一段定义现实任务，下一段转向 RL。

evidence.anchor: complex challenge of dynamically matching passengers

introduction_moves.move: problem: model-free RL 可免系统建模并同时优化收入、司机支付和满意度，但大量 driver/order 使探索和训练困难。上一段的问题由 RL 缓解，下一段进入 MARL 分解。

evidence.anchor: vast action and observation spaces make sufficient exploration difficult

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work: independent MARL 缺全局信息、协作弱；GNN 只引入邻居；CTDE 在千 agent 时受 CoD、慢收敛和次优影响。下一段需要新的集中式组织。

evidence.anchor: fail to capture global information and exhibit limited cooperation

introduction_moves.move: missing_insight: 调度本质上是 centralized，直接利用完整全局状态可能绕开 independent/CTDE 的两端代价；但联合 action、动态维度和 SARL sample scarcity 仍需处理。

evidence.anchor: centralized Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SARL)

introduction_moves.move: method_preview: TD3 与 action decomposition 处理动作空间；BERT self-attention 与 parameter reuse 处理 observation；Stage 1 MARL pre-training 接 Stage 2 centralized fine-tuning 处理样本稀缺。

evidence.anchor: two-stage training strategy

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 第一条将 centralized framework、action decomposition 和 two-stage training 绑定为框架贡献；下一条转到网络和复杂度。

evidence.anchor: We introduce Triple-BERT and propose action decomposition and two-stage training

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 第二条把 BERT self-attention、QK-attention 的 multiplication-to-addition 复杂度表述和 positive normalization 作为网络贡献；下一条转到实证。

evidence.anchor: QK-attention reduces computational complexity and positive normalization mitigates redundancy

introduction_moves.move: result_preview / contribution_list: 第三条给出 Manhattan 数据和约 11.95%、4.26%、22.25% 的 headline 数字，然后进入 Problem Setup。

evidence.anchor: approximately a 11.95% improvement, 4.26% increase, and 22.25% reduction

related_work_moves.move: positioning_only: 引言列出 IDDQN、ISAC、GNN、QMIX、CoPO，以 global information、cooperation、CoD 三个维度制造缺口，细节后移 Appendix F。

evidence.anchor: Independent MARL methods and CTDE methods

related_work_moves.move: limitation_of_prior: 将 independent 的局部视野与 CTDE 的规模代价置于两端，为 centralized SARL 建立缺口。

evidence.anchor: slow convergence and suboptimal performance

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy: Appendix F.1 先区分 model-based 与 model-free RL，再按 DTDE、CTDE、CTCE 组织 ride-sharing dispatch 文献。

evidence.anchor: primarily categorized into model-based and RL-based approaches

related_work_moves.move: chronology + nearest_neighbor_contrast: 早期 DTDE/independent 以 agent 独立视角换取易用性；BMG-Q 引入 GAT 邻域；Enders 使用 MASAC 延迟匹配，Bose 使用 VD/CEVD global reward，Hao 使用 QMIX；比较轴是协作与 CoD。

evidence.anchor: DTDE methods suffer from low cooperation

related_work_moves.move: limitation_of_prior: centralized critic 重新带来 CoD；mean-field、GRPO/OSPO 等依赖同质性压缩规模，但作者指出这些假设未必满足实际。

evidence.anchor: these assumptions are not always met in practice

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + positioning_only: 另列 repositioning、pricing、多模态、UAV/multi-hop 和 fairness 扩展任务，但没有把它们纳入 Triple-BERT 实验边界。

evidence.anchor: integrate order dispatch with other tasks

related_work_moves.move: gap_creation: 总结 centralized training 提高协作却加重 CoD，decentralized 方法缓解 CoD 却带来 non-stationarity/poor coordination，由此引出 centralized SARL。

evidence.anchor: current MARL-based ride-sharing methods face a fundamental dilemma

related_work_moves.move: limitation_of_prior: Appendix F.2 说明 independent learners 的非平稳性、局部最优和 sparse reward；Hysteretic Q-Learning 未消除大规模困难。

evidence.anchor: policies of other agents continuously change

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + nearest_neighbor_contrast: centralized critic、COMA、VD/QMIX/VDAC/QTRAN 依次应对稳定性、credit assignment 和 value mixing，但 agent 数上升仍受 CoD。

evidence.anchor: most of these methods encounter the challenge of CoD

related_work_moves.move: nearest_neighbor_contrast: consensus/communication 通过邻域交换换取协作；CommNet/mean field 丢失具体关系，attention communication 增加训练和 credit assignment 成本，10 轮 exponential graph 相对 30-step horizon 偏高。

evidence.anchor: communication costs and the content of communication

related_work_moves.move: positioning_only: 结尾声称 SARL 直接捕获 global information，从而绕开协作、credit assignment 和 convergence theory 的部分难题；没有新的分类表。

evidence.anchor: SARL-based method circumvents these problems

method_moves.move: setup_notation: 用 W_t、O_t 和 MDP <S,A,R,P> 定义 worker/order 集合、状态、动作、reward 与 transition。

evidence.anchor: state, action, reward, and transition function

method_moves.move: state_problem: order 状态含 origin/destination、pickup time、scheduled arrival；worker 状态含 onboard orders、位置、剩余容量、可用时间，满载或去接单 worker 被禁用。

evidence.anchor: worker state consists of onboard orders, current location, residual capacity, and availability time

method_moves.move: state_problem: 每个 worker 的 action 是 m_t 维、至多一个 1；order 数动态，n=1000、m_t=10 时联合空间约 10^30。

evidence.anchor: action space can reach approximately 10^30

method_moves.move: derive: worker reward 的加权式包含 customer income、worker payout、超时订单数和额外 travel time，global reward 是各 worker reward 之和；TSP 用于路线。

evidence.anchor: reward comprehensively considers platform, workers, and customers

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism: 给定 state/action 时 reward 确定；transition probabilities 不显式建模，由 model-free RL 推断。

evidence.anchor: transition probabilities are not explicitly modeled

method_moves.move: summarize: Overview 将 global information、BERT observation、QK pair utility、action decomposition 和 two-stage training 串成集中式 SARL 方案。

evidence.anchor: centralized SARL to address the large-scale order dispatching task

method_moves.move: define_component: Worker Encoder 用 bi-directional LSTM 编码可变长 onboard sequence，MLP 编码非序列 worker 信息；Order Encoder 用 MLP，使两类 embedding 同维后拼成一条 sequence。

evidence.anchor: bi-directional LSTM extracts variable-length order-sequence features

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism: normalization 处理量级差，ARL 以 MLP(x) 生成权重并做 element-wise product，强调特征重要性差异。

evidence.anchor: Adaptive Re-weighting Layer enables the model to learn input variations

method_moves.move: define_component: Actor-BERT 在 worker/order 全序列上做 self-attention；由于 permutation invariance 去掉 positional embedding，并直接聚合全局 worker 信息。

evidence.anchor: we omit the positional embedding in BERT

method_moves.move: derive: QK-attention 用两个较小网络 f(w_i) 与 g(o_j) 的内积近似 pair network F(w_i,o_j)，让 pair scoring 具备可复用的侧网络。

evidence.anchor: QK-Attention approximates a larger network with two smaller networks

method_moves.move: derive: 复杂度由 O(|F| n m_t) 改写为 O(|f| n + |g| m_t + d n m_t)，论文借 d 很小断言 multiplication-to-addition；这是公式论证，没有 operator-level runtime 测量。

evidence.anchor: QK-attention transforms multiplication complexity into addition complexity

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism: f′=αf、g′=αg 造成等价解冗余；positive normalization 对 Softplus(g(o_j)) 做 L2 归一化，作者声称稳定性提升但承认不保证唯一。

evidence.anchor: normalization significantly improves training stability but does not guarantee a unique solution

method_moves.move: define_component: selected worker/order 的融合 sequence 送入 Critic-BERT，再经 self-attention 与 linear Critic-MLP；TD3 使用两套独立 critics。

evidence.anchor: two separate Critic-BERT and Critic-MLP networks

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm: Stage 1 以共享 policy 的 independent IDDQN 合并 agent records，目标是让 encoder 学一般 embedding，而非训练最终 dispatch policy。

evidence.anchor: feature extractor learns general feature-extracting capabilities

method_moves.move: derive + instantiate_algorithm: normalized QK-attention 形成 Y_t；bipartite graph 的 edge 是 pair Q-value，ILP 最大化 global Q，并将不可用 worker 的整行设为 −∞。

evidence.anchor: ILP solves the maximizing bipartite matching problem

method_moves.move: scope_boundary: 作者承认 independent assumption 不可靠，并把它明确限于 pre-training；centralized fine-tuning 不再依赖该假设。

evidence.anchor: After pre-training, our centralized SARL framework no longer relies on the independence assumption

method_moves.move: state_problem: Stage 2 离散 action 面临巨大联合空间、动态 order 数/内容导致固定维概率向量失效，以及 order 互斥导致 worker 不能独立采样。

evidence.anchor: the actions in order dispatching are discrete and the action space is exceedingly large

method_moves.move: define_component: utility matrix M_t 追加 no-order utility N_t，通过 logit model 得到 per-worker action probability P_t=Softmax(M_t)。

evidence.anchor: utility matrix is expanded with the utility of choosing no order

method_moves.move: derive: joint policy 被假设为选中 pair probabilities 的乘积经单调 z 映射；作者明确称 P 和 z 是 virtual constructs，用来限制 policy class。

evidence.anchor: the probability P does not exist in reality but serves as a virtual construct

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm: inference 在单调 z 与 log 下最大化 selected pair log-probability，构造 TD3 bipartite graph 用 ILP 解码；训练对 P_t 加噪声，噪声渐减使 policy 从 random 向 greedy 转移。

evidence.anchor: we can find the action that maximizes the joint policy by ILP

method_moves.move: derive + connect_to_prediction: action selection 不可微时，用 Q−B 加权的 log P approximate policy gradient；B 简化为 0，actor loss 取 −∇J。

evidence.anchor: we employ an approximate policy gradient optimization method

method_moves.move: derive: critic 按 vanilla TD3 的双 Q min target、慢更新 target network 和 probability-matrix smoothing noise 更新。

evidence.anchor: target network updates more slowly to provide a stable target

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把具有全局冲突约束的 ride-sharing dispatch 重写为 centralized SARL：BERT 在全 worker/order 集合上聚合信息，QK-attention 产生可复用 pair utility，product-policy 假设把联合概率映射为 per-pair 概率，ILP 把它解成匹配；Stage 1 independent IDDQN 只作 encoder warm start，Stage 2 才进行 centralized TD3。实证优势在高订单量和 pickup/service 指标上最明显。〔p.3–8、p.10、p.23–25〕
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 MDP 与 reward Eq.1、network Fig.2、policy Eq.5–8、baseline Table1、FHV Table2、training Fig.3、两项主消融和 single-point-of-failure 边界；这些对象覆盖优化目标、解码方式、比较结果和主要代价。〔p.3–10〕
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 action-space lower bound、ILP constraints、policy-gradient derivation、两套算法、训练/仿真/基线配置、跨场景表格和 related work，另以 Figure 6 给出多指标细分；正文通过 Appendix A/B/C/D/E/F 和 Fig.6 调用。〔p.17–29〕
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是把动态组合动作先转为可解的 bipartite matching，再让同一 BERT 表征服务 utility、概率和 critic；Fig.1/2 落地数据流与复合结构，Eq.5–7 把启发式解码连接到训练目标，Table4 把两项关键 removal 放在同一表。〔p.3–4、p.8、p.23〕
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是 centralized execution、BERT/QK、ILP/action decomposition、two-stage training、reward 结构和 baseline 适配同时变化；没有直接去掉 centralization 或 decomposition，也没有 runtime 的 solver/network 分解、reward component 分解、seed 列表或系统性公平/碳排放评估。〔p.9–10、p.21–25〕
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 动态联合动作一旦被约束为局部概率乘积，正文应同时给出冲突约束的可执行解码、离散选择如何进入训练梯度，以及一个去掉该分解的对照；复杂度直觉不能单独闭合机制。〔p.7–8、p.17–18〕
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有集中式决策权、可收集全局状态、worker/order 冲突可由匹配求解、输入具有集合置换不变性且实时预算足够的任务。通信受限、隐私分片、必须分布式执行或要求容错隔离的系统不能由本文证据直接外推；single-point-of-failure 仍未测试。〔p.5、p.10、p.22–25〕
